description.value: Shandhar Hut is a family-run Punjabi Indian restaurant in Chilliwack that has been serving the community since the early 1970s and has been voted Best Indian Restaurant locally for over 20 years, including the 2024 Flavour of the Chillies award. The kitchen focuses on authentic tandoor specialties, aromatic curries, and a broad vegetarian menu, all prepared with fresh local ingredients and family recipes. With two Chilliwack locations and full online ordering, it offers a reliable hot-meal stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://shandharhut.com/ loaded successfully and confirms the Young Rd address (8835 Young Rd, Chilliwack, BC V2P 4P6) and provides a phone number (604) 793-0188 absent from OSM. The menu page explicitly confirms gluten-free and dairy-free options plus a dedicated Vegetarian's Delight section, and the homepage/header prominently advertises online ordering and takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Shandar Hut' is a misspelling — the business consistently uses 'Shandhar Hut' across its website and domain name.
